existing_types: A writable class-metadata block containing two statically initialized objects in declaration order: `HSD_FogInfo hsdFog = { FogInfoInit }` and `HSD_ClassInfo hsdFogAdj = { FogAdjInfoInit }`. Their remaining class-information fields are populated by `hsdInitClassInfo` during class initialization.
A 64-byte read-only character-literal pool containing NUL-terminated diagnostic and class-registration strings, together with any compiler-required alignment padding.
A 24-byte aligned small-data string block containing the NUL-terminated HSD class identifiers "hsd_fog" and "hsd_fogadj", with trailing alignment padding.

Read-only small-data constant pool for fog.c. Its source-visible named object is `const GXColor HSD_Fog_804DE6F0 = { 0 }`, a four-byte zero RGBA value; the rest of the section holds compiler-emitted floating-point constants associated with the module's fog calculations and assignments.

Parameterless class-info initialization callback with signature `static void FogAdjInfoInit(void)`; it initializes an HSD class descriptor with metadata extent `sizeof(HSD_FogAdjInfo)` and object-instance extent `sizeof(HSD_FogAdj)`.

A file-local, no-argument, no-return class-information initializer with signature `static void FogInfoInit(void)`; it configures an `HSD_FogInfo` descriptor for `HSD_Fog` instances derived from the global `hsdObj` class descriptor.
static void FogRelease(HSD_Fog* fog), used as the HSD_Fog class release callback through an explicit cast when assigned to the generic class release slot.

Animation-update callback with signature `void (void* obj, enum_t type, HSD_ObjData* val)`; `obj` is interpreted as `HSD_Fog*`, handled discriminator values are 1, 2, 5–8, and 20, and every handled attribute consumes the floating-point `val->fv` member.

Signature `void HSD_FogAdjInit(HSD_FogAdj* adj, HSD_FogAdjDesc* desc)`: `adj` is an optional mutable destination containing signed 16-bit center, unsigned 16-bit width, and an Mtx44 matrix; `desc` is an optional descriptor containing unsigned 16-bit center and width plus an Mtx44 matrix. The routine returns no value.

Signature: HSD_FogAdj* HSD_FogAdjLoadDesc(HSD_FogAdjDesc* desc). The descriptor pointer is nullable; the return value is a non-null mutable runtime HSD_FogAdj under normal execution, with allocation failure handled by assertions.
Signature `void HSD_FogInit(HSD_Fog* fog, HSD_FogDesc* desc)`. `fog` is a nullable writable destination object and `desc` is a nullable initialization descriptor; the routine returns no value.
Function signature: void HSD_FogInterpretAnim(HSD_Fog* fog). The HSD_Fog pointer is nullable; passing NULL performs no work.

Function signature: HSD_Fog* HSD_FogLoadDesc(HSD_FogDesc* desc). The descriptor is required to be non-null because the function unconditionally reads desc->fogadjdesc after base initialization; the returned mutable HSD_Fog is newly allocated, and allocation failure is handled by assertions rather than returned as NULL during normal execution.
Signature: `void HSD_FogReqAnim(HSD_Fog* fog, f32 frame)`. `fog` identifies the fog object whose animation is requested, and `frame` is forwarded as the requested animation frame.

void (HSD_Fog* fog, u32 flags, f32 frame); fog is nullable, flags is an animation-selection bitmask whose 0x200 bit selects fog animation, and frame is an animation-frame position forwarded unchanged to the attached HSD_AObj.

`void HSD_FogSet(HSD_Fog* fog)`: a synchronous GX state setter taking a nullable HSD_Fog pointer and returning no value. A non-null object supplies a GXFogType-compatible mode, floating-point start and end depths, GXColor, and an optional HSD_FogAdj containing a center, width, and projection matrix.

Function with signature `void HSD_FogAddAnim(HSD_Fog* fog, HSD_AObjDesc* desc)`. It is a null-tolerant mutator whose first argument owns the resulting runtime HSD_AObj and whose second argument is a nullable serialized animation-controller descriptor.

subjects.role_and_type: Parameter HSD_Fog* fog. Null disables depth fog and returns without range-adjustment reset. Non-null requires current CObj, programs type/range/color with camera near/far, then enables range adjustment or explicitly disables it. Center formula is viewport_x + viewport_width*(center+320)/640, converted to s32 then clamped 0..640. Width zero reconstructs current projection; nonzero uses stored matrix.

evidence.why: Null disables depth fog and returns without range-adjustment reset. Non-null requires current CObj, programs type/range/color with camera near/far, then enables range adjustment or explicitly disables it. Center formula is viewport_x + viewport_width*(center+320)/640, converted to s32 then clamped 0..640. Width zero reconstructs current projection; nonzero uses stored matrix.
